title: Shipper Commitments: Where the Basin's Steel Is Contracted
dek: This page shows where the basin's steel is contracted and where it is all spot. The figure draws the contracted corridors that already have atlas geography: Southern Lights at 165 kb/d committed through 2030, Cochin at 90 kb/d or more, Explorer's Item 118 program at a 60 kb/d minimum, and Line 9 at 260 of 300 kb/d held by two refiners. The table carries the two committed systems not redrawn here (Trans Mountain 707.5 kb/d firm; Keystone 585 kb/d on its AIF basis) and the commitments map's most important single fact: the Enbridge Mainline, the basin's largest system, is committed zero. Every Mainline barrel moves uncommitted under the Mainline Tolling Settlement.
